stem: \[y = x^{2} - 3x\] \[y = x + 12\] The system of equations above has two solutions. If \((a, b)\) is the solution with \(a > 0\), what is the value of \(b\)?
solution: Set the expressions equal: \(x^{2} - 3x = x + 12\), so \(x^{2} - 4x - 12 = 0\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sols = solve([Eq(y, x**2 - 3*x), Eq(y, x + 12)], [x, y], dict=True)
assert len(sols) == 2
b = [s[y] for s in sols if s[x] > 0][0]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [b] == [18]
